about: The choices [JEngine] leaves open, searched rather than fixed. Scored against the same tables as the literal board, by a rule with no threshold to ratchet: at or under the printed value in every cell. Nothing here is read by the literal board, and nothing in literal.json is read here. The candidates are plan/search.py's: one plan per cell, the cut searched under one lexicographic objective (max targets, then max intermediates, then FLOPs), recorded per (L, n_batches) in searched_cuts.json so a replay does not re-search.
